study.aim: Determine whether actual source-owned agentic software engineering work is accurately findable, attributable, and competitively useful before and after an independently received Software Fabrication ASSIST public release.
preconditions: No software.assist.561.group live public service, customer, search-index entry or third-party answer-engine citation is inferred from a source roster record or this query plan.

Each real measurement is a dated, provider/surface/mode/locale-qualified observation with independently verified original URL and truthful entity attribution; missing is unobserved, not a ranking failure.
Branded and unbranded roles are distinct. Unbranded queries have no obligation to cite the 561 Group; competitor and DORA controls should not be misattributed.
Search index entries, generated responses, citations, user traffic, qualified leads, customer acceptance and paid transactions are separate claims with separate original evidence.
Preserve documented provider versions, price tiers, feature support and independent receiving on any Software Mind performance comparison; provider-reported 10x is not our baseline.
No product/source marketing page is published under an unadmitted authority; private mission receipts and third-party customer material must not enter the public query ledger.
study.comparison: Record two preregistered waves per named search/answer engine surface after exact public release when available. Preserve identical panel version, query bytes, locale, surface mode and sampling method; compare branded entity resolution, source-accurate citation and real beneficiary navigation separately. Report missing/unobservable states, preserve negative and contradictory evidence, never claim AI citation uplift from generated metadata alone.
